Description

Larkhall Park boasts top quality outdoor tennis courts that are perfect for tennis fans in and around South London. It caters for beginners, intermediates and expert tennis players in equal measure. This facility has hard (macadam) tennis courts and these are looked after impeccably to ensure there are no untoward bounces during a crucial point. The tennis courts at Larkhall Park are well kept with the lines and markings clearly visible. Tennis is a great sport as it caters for various formats. Singles is the most popular, but if you have four players keen for a knockabout then doubles is a thrilling game to play.

This facility has floodlights. These powerful spotlights remove the concern about it being too dark and mean that you can play all year round.

Customers will be pleased to know that the venue operates a pay-as-you-play booking system. This means sports enthusiasts can just turn up and play depending on availability and book on a pay as you play basis. This method avoids the monthly membership charges and gives you the freedom to play as and when you like, without the commitment of a weekly game or a membership fee.

For those who like the security of knowing you can play at the same time every week without fail, you can make a block booking at Larkhall Park. This ensures you stay in the game and keep up your fitness on a regular basis. The very accommodating team at Playfinder will help you to secure your preferred slot or if that isn’t available, we will help you to secure the best alternative. A block booking is a booking made for a set number of consecutive weeks, on average this is 10 weeks.

If you're looking to travel using public transport, then the nearest station is Stockwell. This facility has excellent public transport links making it easy for all participants to reach the venue.
